There's a condom you can put in 8 hours before sex ⏰

It's the internal (female) condom: a soft, thin sleeve with a ring at each end that goes inside the vagina. Used correctly every time it's up to 95% effective (about 79% with real-life mistakes), and it also helps protect against STIs.

One rule: never use it together with a normal condom. They can make each other split.

Sources: NHS, NHS inform, MedlinePlus, Kaiser Permanente.

Did you know female condoms existed?
